title: anthemis tenuifolia
intro: Anthemis tenuifolia, commonly known as Japanese chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from insomnia, anxiety, and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis tenuifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, which help to soothe and calm the body and mind. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
